construction: Each source paragraph was split at the sentence boundary nearest its midpoint (sentence-final punctuation, skipping abbreviations; single-sentence paragraphs fall back to the clause boundary nearest the midpoint). prompt = head of the paragraph; completion = ' ' + tail, mirroring prepare.py's completion convention. Line wraps from the plain-text files were removed when transcribing; no other edits.
name: OUROBOROS R3 common frozen eval
purpose: One frozen eval set shared by every R3 arm and seed (Run Spec R3 section 3), replacing the R1/R2 protocol in which each trajectory froze eval groups from its own cycle-0 corpus (base perplexities 12-61, only percent-drop comparable). These texts appear nowhere in the loop: not in data/seeds, not in any corpus, not in any prompt.
